# Experience design

A tool-neutral design workspace. `DESIGN.md` holds the design rules and
tokens. Each feature gets `<feature-slug>/design.md`, with the link to its
design tool project, the decisions taken, the states covered
(empty, error, loading) and the export date, and `<feature-slug>/exports/`,
with the exported bundle or screens (HTML, PNG, PDF) kept as review evidence.
A task links its design with `design: workspace/experience-design/<slug>/design.md`.
